value.rationale: Refines the diagonal S_n family studied by Ramos–Yun into all independent side permutations and class-exchanging automorphisms, detecting a nontrivial single irreducible full-automorphism homology module for every balanced size r≥4. This captures structural information absent from Betti numbers and the prior diagonal restriction, and applies uniformly to all rectangular K_{m,n}, m,n≥3.
